# Redaction only — not a successful git clone.
# URL shape: user:password@host (+ matching repoToken). Wrong password → 401.
# useExecLogs=true so any exec journaling is on while we assert the sentinel
# never appears; userinfo is masked as ***@host.

git-authfail-start

cp .apinfra.secret .apinfra

exec apinfra
stderr 'http://\*\*\*@'
! stderr 'SecPassUserinfo99'
stderr 'done duration='

! exec grep -R --exclude='.apinfra*' SecPassUserinfo99 $HOME

git-authfail-stop

-- .apinfra.secret --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
repo=http://git:SecPassUserinfo99@127.0.0.1:18081/repo
repoToken=SecPassUserinfo99
useExecLogs=true

-- .env --
